Enemy Appearance |active_in = [[Challenge Trials]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = +15% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies are Flying (after wave 4)|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Flying Enemies''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Limitation Makes Creativity]] and before [[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match. '''Flying Enemies''' is part of a group of six modifiers consisting of itself, [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Committed]], [[Speedy Enemies]] and [[Glass]]. These six modifiers cannot have their total reward boost exceed 50%, limiting their boosts to that. This does not prevent modifiers not part of this group from applying their boosts. For example, [[Fog]] will still apply its 20% reward boost when all six are applied, increasing the reward boost from 50% to 70%, though still lower from the expected 95%. ==Effects== When applied, every enemy after Wave 5 will become a [[Flying]] enemy, granting them various immunities and making them undetectable without flying detection. This will also give them white wings. ==Update History== *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Flying Enemies''' added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[V1.78.0]] **{{Bug}} Enemies do not have wings anymore while the modifier is active. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.7]] **Added a cap for the total reward boost from the [[Glass]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Speedy Enemies]], '''Flying Enemies''' and [[Committed]], limiting their total boosts to 50%, though this is only active in [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Reward boost lowered from +20% to +15%. **Cap for total reward boost from [[Glass]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Speedy Enemies]], '''Flying Enemies''' and [[Committed]] expanded to all gamemodes. {{ModifierNavBox}}
